statements.statement: CPT 93229 mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered
The patient had recurrent episodes of palpitations, lightheadedness, and intermittent syncope
These symptoms were suggestive of symptomatic atrial fibrillation (I48.91)
The patient had sick sinus syndrome (I49.5)
The patient had a documented history of unexplained cardiac arrhythmias (I49.9)
Continuous electrocardiographic monitoring during daily activities was needed to correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances
The claim was denied with reason code CO-197
The denial was based on failure to obtain required precertification or prior authorization before services were rendered
The provider may submit a formal appeal within ninety days of the denial notice
